import MilneLib.Quotient.GeometricQuotient
import Mathlib.Algebra.Algebra.Subalgebra.Operations

/-!
# Opens descended through a geometric quotient

An invariant geometric quotient identifies a stable source open with an open
of the quotient.  This file records the saturation and topology bookkeeping
once, so quotient constructions can work with named target opens.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry TopologicalSpace

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction

variable {G : Type u} [Group G] {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
  {act : G →* Aut X} {q : X ⟶ Y}

/-- Equal stable opens have the same fixed-section ring. -/
noncomputable def fixedSectionsRingEquivOfEq {U V : X.Opens}
    (hU : IsStableOpen act U) (hV : IsStableOpen act V) (h : U = V) :
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hU
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hV
    FixedPoints.subring Γ(X, U) G ≃+* FixedPoints.subring Γ(X, V) G := by
  subst V
  exact RingEquiv.refl _

namespace IsGeometricQuotient

variable (hq : IsGeometricQuotient act q)

/-- A stable open is saturated for the orbit quotient. -/
theorem preimage_image_stableOpen (hq : IsGeometricQuotient act q)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsStableOpen act U) :
    q.base ⁻¹' (q.base '' (U : Set X)) = (U : Set X) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    change q.base x ∈ q.base '' (U : Set X) at hx
    obtain ⟨z, hzU, hzx⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ :=
      (MilneLib.StableGroupAction.IsGeometricQuotient.eq_iff hq z x).mp hzx
    have hinv : (act g).hom ≫ (act g⁻¹).hom = 𝟙 X := by
      rw [← act_mul_hom act g⁻¹ g, inv_mul_cancel, act_one_hom]
    have hz : (act g⁻¹).hom.base x = z := by
      have hh := congrArg (fun f : X ⟶ X => f.base z) hinv
      change (act g⁻¹).hom.base ((act g).hom.base z) = z at hh
      rw [hg] at hh
      exact hh
    have hxpre : (act g⁻¹).hom.base x ∈ (U : Set X) := by
      rw [hz]
      simpa using hzU
    rw [← hU g⁻¹]
    exact hxpre
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

/-- The open of the quotient corresponding to a stable source open. -/
noncomputable def quotientOpen (hq : IsGeometricQuotient act q)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsStableOpen act U) : Y.Opens :=
  ⟨q.base '' (U : Set X), by
    apply (hq.isQuotientMap.isOpen_preimage).mp
    rw [preimage_image_stableOpen hq U hU]
    exact U.isOpen⟩

@[simp]
theorem quotientOpen_coe (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsStableOpen act U) :
    (hq.quotientOpen U hU : Set Y) = q.base '' (U : Set X) := rfl

@[simp]
theorem preimage_quotientOpen (hq : IsGeometricQuotient act q)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsStableOpen act U) :
    q ⁻¹ᵁ hq.quotientOpen U hU = U := by
  ext x
  change x ∈ q.base ⁻¹' (q.base '' (U : Set X)) ↔ x ∈ (U : Set X)
  rw [preimage_image_stableOpen hq U hU]

/-- Pullback identifies sections on a descended open with the fixed sections on
the corresponding saturated preimage.  The preimage open is retained in the
statement to avoid transport across equal `Opens` values. -/
noncomputable def quotientOpenSectionsFixedEquiv
    (hq : IsGeometricQuotient act q) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : IsStableOpen act U) :
    let V := hq.quotientOpen U hU
    let hV := isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant act q hq.invariant V
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hV
    Γ(Y, V) ≃+* FixedPoints.subring Γ(X, q ⁻¹ᵁ V) G := by
  let V := hq.quotientOpen U hU
  let hV := isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant act q hq.invariant V
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hV
  let r : Γ(Y, V) →+* Γ(X, q ⁻¹ᵁ V) := (q.app V).hom
  let φ : Γ(Y, V) →+* FixedPoints.subring Γ(X, q ⁻¹ᵁ V) G :=
    r.codRestrict _ (fun s => by
      change ∀ g : G, (actApp act hV g⁻¹).hom (r s) = r s
      intro g
      have hs := ((hq.mem_range_app V (r s)).mp ⟨s, rfl⟩) g⁻¹
      simpa [sectionsMulSemiringAction_smul_def] using hs)
  exact RingEquiv.ofBijective φ
    ⟨fun a b hab => hq.app_injective V (congrArg Subtype.val hab), by
      intro a
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (hq.mem_range_app V a.1).mpr (by
        intro g
        have ha := a.property g⁻¹
        change (actApp act hV g).hom a.1 = a.1
        simpa [sectionsMulSemiringAction_smul_def] using ha)
      refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hs⟩

@[simp]
theorem quotientOpenSectionsFixedEquiv_apply_val
    (hq : IsGeometricQuotient act q) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : IsStableOpen act U) (s : Γ(Y, hq.quotientOpen U hU)) :
    let hV := isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant act q hq.invariant
      (hq.quotientOpen U hU)
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hV
    ((hq.quotientOpenSectionsFixedEquiv U hU s :
      FixedPoints.subring Γ(X, q ⁻¹ᵁ hq.quotientOpen U hU) G) :
      Γ(X, q ⁻¹ᵁ hq.quotientOpen U hU)) =
      (q.app (hq.quotientOpen U hU)).hom s := by
  rfl

/-- Pullback identifies sections on a descended open with the fixed sections
on the original stable source open. -/
noncomputable def quotientOpenSectionsEquiv
    (hq : IsGeometricQuotient act q) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : IsStableOpen act U) :
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hU
    Γ(Y, hq.quotientOpen U hU) ≃+* FixedPoints.subring Γ(X, U) G :=
  (hq.quotientOpenSectionsFixedEquiv U hU).trans
    (fixedSectionsRingEquivOfEq
      (isStableOpen_preimage_of_invariant act q hq.invariant
        (hq.quotientOpen U hU)) hU (hq.preimage_quotientOpen U hU))

end IsGeometricQuotient
end MilneLib.StableGroupAction
